## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/check-contrast.mjs` passes
- [ ] Checked in both light and dark mode
- [ ] Any new colour was added to the palette blocks in `theme.css`
      (sections 3 and 4), not inlined in a rule
- [ ] No remote assets, fonts or `@import url(https://…)` added
- [ ] `manifest.json` version left alone (maintainer bumps it at release time)
